acceptanceJudgements.bullet: Requester/contributor cannot impersonate owner or approve release/acceptance.
acceptanceJudgements.evidence: packages/contracts/auth/policy.ts is a closed permission map: intent/release/publication/assignment/acceptance.approve and invitation.create exist only for private owner; permits() fails closed for unknown scopes, roles and prototype-pollution keys (__proto__, constructor, toString) and denies external owner; gates.test.ts proves the request-bound gate (WeakMap keyed by request object) ignores forged x-actor-role headers and body role/actorId fields (requester/operator 403, contributor 401, dispatch only for the DB-verified owner, dispatched id equals the verified session id); session-store.test.ts rejects a stored contributor role in the private service; routes.test.ts rejects client role injection at login with 400. Scope observation (not a failure): no release/acceptance HTTP routes exist yet, so the gate is exercised at the handler/gate level; authority enforcement wherever future routes dispatch is a stated obligation for later tasks and no route can currently approve anything.

acceptanceJudgements.bullet: Cross-contributor and private-resource access fails server-side; invalid sessions and revoked invitations fail.
acceptanceJudgements.evidence: resources.test.ts + implementation review: PrivateResourceAccess.intent joins the account, current head revision and an unexpired session inside the SQL (actor.role/id/token_hash bound as parameters; owner sees all, requester only revision.requester_id=actor.id; operator denied requester evidence; traversal IDs denied); ExternalResourceAccess binds resource.contributor_id=actor.id with the reservation-contributor join; projections are positive allowlists (intent: id/version/state; submission: id/reservationId/version) excluding patch, permit, hashes and pre-feedback stage names; missing and cross-identity resources share one denial. Sessions: HMAC-signed scope-prefixed cookies (scope inside the HMAC input, so a private cookie cannot verify at the external API - tested), token stored only as SHA-256 hash, expiry>now() and NOT disabled required in every query, duplicate cookies rejected before touching the store, CSRF token must be 64-hex and hash-match for every mutation, scrypt N=32768 password hashing with timing-safe compare and dummy-hash equalization, login rate limit 20/5min/IP, fixed error allowlist with a canary-leak test, host-only cookie (no Domain attribute, asserted), HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, __Host- prefix + Secure + TLS fail-closed in production mode. Invitations: redemption requires locked NOT revoked AND redeemed_at IS NULL AND expires_at>now() FOR UPDATE with rollback; creation re-locks owner account + exact session token/CSRF hashes + expiry inside the transaction (regression covered by session-store.test.ts asserting the SQL and the rollback on missing authority).
